name: Microsoft Purview
sku: The Microsoft Purview data governance solutions (Data Map and Unified Catalog). Its data security and compliance solutions (Insider Risk, eDiscovery, Audit and others) are not scored. Documented as a Microsoft product; it is grouped with the Azure services so the picker offers it beside them.

bands.note: The Data Map inventories data assets and metadata, and the Unified Catalog organises them into governance domains, data products and glossary terms, searchable with an AI-powered copilot. Scanning and classification reach well beyond Azure: on-premises SQL Server, Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, Snowflake, BigQuery and more can be registered and scanned as sources, so a system the pipeline reads from, not just what it stores, can be catalogued.
Attaches policies to glossary terms and critical data elements, manages self-service access requests, and applies sensitivity labels and data loss prevention across the estate.

The platform keeps an inventory of data assets, their metadata and their lineage, so the topography of the data estate can be understood. Lineage is captured from many source databases directly (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, SAP and more, each registered and scanned), not only from what already sits inside the estate.
Data quality rules are set through governance domains, data products and the assets themselves, and produce quality scores at asset, data product and domain level.

presentation.tagline: Data catalog, policy, lineage and quality scoring across a Microsoft data estate.
